questions.question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 8400 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

Principal amount(P) = 8400 

Time = 2 year 

Rate % = 10%

**Formula used:- **

Compound Interest = P ( 1 + R/100 )T - P

where T = time and P = principal R = Rate of interest 

**Calculation:- **

Compound Interest = 8400 ( 1 + 10/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 8400 (110/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 10164 - 8400 = 1764** 

 ∴ The required answer is__ 1764__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

R% = 1/10 

P = 10

A = 10 + 1 =11 

⇒ Principle → Amount 

 

⇒ 10 → 11

For 2 years

⇒ (10)² → (11)² 

⇒ 100 → 121 

So, CI = 121 - 100 = 21

Comparing the real data 

 ⇒ CI = (21/100) × 8400 =1764

questions.question: 14 workers working 16 hours per day can demolish a building in 81 days. In how many days 18 workers working 24 hours per day can demolish the same building?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct MDH formula: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

⇒ 14 × 81 × 16 = 18 × D₂ × 24

⇒ D₂ = (14 × 81 × 16) ÷ (18 × 24)

⇒ D₂ = 18144 ÷ 432

⇒ D₂ = 42 days

**∴ The correct answer is 42 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Workers in first group (M₁) = 14

Days taken (D₁) = 81

Hours per day (H₁) = 16

Workers in second group (M₂) = 18

Hours per day (H₂) = 24

**Formula Used:**

Since the building to be demolished is the same, the total work is constant (W₁ = W₂).

MDH Rule: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

 
 Group 1
 14 M × 81 D × 16 H
 
 =
 
 
 Group 2
 18 M × D × 24 H

**Calculation:**

⇒ 14 × 81 × 16 = 18 × D₂ × 24

⇒ D₂ = (14 × 81 × 16) ÷ (18 × 24)

Simplifying the ratios step-by-step:

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (81 ÷ 18) × (16 ÷ 24)

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (9 ÷ 2) × (2 ÷ 3)

Canceling out the common factor of 2:

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (9 ÷ 3)

⇒ D₂ = 14 × 3

⇒ D₂ = 42 days

**∴ The correct answer is 42 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

The rule states that if M₁ persons can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hours a day, and M₂ persons can do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hours a day, then (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Work Equivalence Principle

When two groups perform the exact same task, the total effort measured in man-hours or man-days remains constant. Thus, Total Work = Men × Days × Hours.

Direct and Inverse Proportions

More work requires more workers (direct proportion, M ∝ W). More workers require fewer days to complete the same work (inverse proportion, M ∝ 1 ÷ D).
</p

questions.question: Rs. 15000 is divided among E, F and G. E's share and F's share are in the ratio of 3 ∶ 2. F's share and G's share are in the ratio of 6 ∶ 5. How much amount will F receive?
questions.solution:
**Given:-** 

Total share = 15000 

The ratio of E and F shares is 3 : 2

The ratio of F and G shares is 6 : 5

**Calculation:- **

Total share = Rs. 15000

Ratio of E and F share is 3 : 2

The ratio of F and G share is 6 : 5

⇒ E/F = 3/2 and F/G = 6/5 

⇒ E/F = (3/2) × (3/3) and F/G = (6/5) 

 

⇒ E/F = 9/6 and F/G = 6/5 

⇒ E : F : G = 9 : 6 : 5

Let E's, F's, and G's share be 9x, 6x, 5x

⇒ 9x + 6x + 5x = 15000

⇒ 20x = 15000 

⇒ x = 750

F's share = 6 × 750= Rs 4500

**∴ The required answer is __4500__.**

questions.question: A car left 4 hours later than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 480 km away in time, it had to increase its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed of the car?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let the usual speed of the car be ‘x’ km/hr.

Time is taken to cover 480 km = Distance/Speed = 480/x hrs.

But, when the car left 4 hours left, the Speed of the car = (x + 10) km/hr.

⇒ Time taken = Distance/Speed = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480/x) - 4 = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480- 4x)/x = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480 - 4x)(x + 10) = 480x

⇒ 480x + 4800 - 4x² - 40x = 480x

 

⇒ 4x² + 40x - 4800 = 0 

⇒ x² + 10x - 1200 = 0 

⇒ x2 + 40x - 30x - 1200 = 0

⇒ x(x + 40) - 30(x + 40) = 0

⇒ (x + 40)(x - 30) = 0

⇒ x = -40, 30 

∵ Speed cannot be negative 

**∴ The required answer is __30__. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) [time difference]

⇒ [x × (x + 10)/10] × 4 = 480

⇒ x(x + 10) = 1200

⇒ x × (x + 10) = 30 × 40

⇒ x = 30 km/hr

questions.question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs.5704 in 3 years and to Rs.6072 in 4 years. The sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Amount in 3rd year = Rs. 5704

Amount in 4th year = Rs. 6072

Time difference = 1 year

**Formula used:-**

Amount = Principal + S.I.

**Calculation:-**

S.I. in 1 year = 6072 - 5704 = Rs. 368

S.I. in 3 year = 3 × 368 = Rs. 1104

⇒ Amount = Principal + S.I. 

⇒ 5704 = Principal + 1104

⇒ Principal = 5704 - 1104 = Rs. 4600

**∴ The sum (principal) is Rs.__ 4600__.**

questions.question: A trader allowed a discount of 25 percent on a trolley bag having list price of Rs. 1488 and earns a profit of 20 percent. What is the cost price of the trolley bag?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of Cost Price (CP) to Marked Price (MP) can be directly written as (100 − Discount%) : (100 + Profit%).

CP : MP = (100 − 25) : (100 + 20) = 75 : 120 = 5 : 8

Here, the Marked Price (8 parts) = Rs. 1488 ⇒ 1 part = 1488 ÷ 8 = Rs. 186

Therefore, Cost Price (5 parts) = 186 × 5 = Rs. 930

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 930.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 CP = ?
 
 
 SP
 
 
 MP = 1488

 
• 
 

 +20% Profit

 
• 
 

 -25% Discount

 CP / MP = (100 − 25) / (100 + 20) = 5 / 8

**Given:**

List Price (MP) = Rs. 1488

Discount = 25%

Profit = 20%

**Formula Used:**

CP / MP = (100 − D%) / (100 + P%)

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP / 1488 = (100 − 25) / (100 + 20)

⇒ CP / 1488 = 75 / 120

⇒ CP / 1488 = 5 / 8

⇒ CP = 1488 × (5 / 8)

⇒ CP = 186 × 5

⇒ CP = 930

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 930.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Selling Price (SP) Connections

The Selling Price links the Cost Price and Marked Price. SP can be calculated from CP as: SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100, and from MP as: SP = MP × (100 − D%) ÷ 100.

Successive Discount

If two successive discounts of D₁% and D₂% are given, the equivalent single discount is calculated using the formula: (D₁ + D₂ − D₁ × D₂ ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a shopkeeper claims to sell goods at Cost Price but uses a false weight, the actual Profit % is found using: (True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight × 100.
</p

questions.question: Average of 9 numbers is 47. If a number is removed, then the average becomes 48. Which number was removed?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

Average of 9 numbers is 47 

**Formula used:- ** 

Sum = Average × Numbers

 

**Calculation:-**

The average of a set of 9 numbers is 47

∴ Total = 9 × 47 = 423 

If one number is removed then the average of 8 numbers is 48.

∴ Total = 8 × 48 = 384

Then the number removed = 423 − 384 = 39 

**∴ The required answer is __39.__**

questions.question: What is the Highest Common Factor of 25, 15 and 75?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Find the minimum difference between any two given numbers: 25 − 15 = 10.

The HCF must be a factor of this difference (factors of 10 are 1, 2, 5, 10).

Check the highest factor 10: it does not divide 15.

Check the next highest factor 5: it exactly divides 25, 15, and 75.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 25, 15, and 75.

**Formula Used:**

HCF is the product of the lowest powers of all common prime factors.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 25 = 5 × 5 = 5²

⇒ Prime factorization of 75 = 3 × 5 × 5 = 3 × 5²

⇒ The only common prime factor among all three numbers is 5.

⇒ The lowest power of 5 present in all factorizations is 5¹.

⇒ Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest multiple that is common to two or more numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. They do not need to be prime numbers individually (e.g., 8 and 15).

Product of Two Numbers Rule

For any two given numbers a and b: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b). This relationship applies strictly to two numbers only.
</p

Directly substitute the ratio values: X = 3 and Y = 2.

Required Ratio = (X − Y) : (X + Y)

Required Ratio = (3 − 2) : (3 + 2)

Required Ratio = 1 : 5

**∴ The correct option is B.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: X : Y = 3 : 2

Formula Used: If X : Y = a : b, then (X − Y) : (X + Y) = (a − b) : (a + b)

 
 
• 
 
• 
 X = 3 units
 
 
• 
 Y = 2 units
 
• 
 Difference (X − Y) = 3 − 2 = 1 unit
 Sum (X + Y) = 3 + 2 = 5 units
 Ratio = 1 : 5

⇒ (X − Y) = 3k − 2k = k

**__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If a/b = c/d, then (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d). This is useful for solving complex ratio equations quickly.

Duplicate and Triplicate Ratios

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², and the triplicate ratio is a³ : b³.

Inverse Ratio

The inverse ratio of a : b is b : a. It is also expressed as (1/a) : (1/b).</p

questions.question: Difference between the circumferences of two circles is 4.4 cm and radius of smaller circle is 1.4 cm. The radius of the larger circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

(1) Difference between the circumferences of the two circles is 4.4 cm

(2) Radius of the smaller circle is 1.4 cm 

**Formula used:- **

The circumference of a circle = 2πr where r = radius

**Calculation:- **

Circumference of larger circle - Circumference of smaller circle = 4.4 cm 

⇒ 2πR -2π(1.4) = 4.4 

 

⇒ 2π[R - 1.4] = 4.4 

⇒ 2 × (22/7) [R - 1.4] = 4.4 

⇒ R - 1.4 = .7 

⇒ R = 2.1 cm ** 

∴ The required answer is __2.1__ cm.**

questions.question: Average of 8 numbers is 44. The average of first three numbers is 50 and the average of next two numbers is 52. If the sixth number is 6 and 8 less than seventh and eighth number respectively, then what is the value of eighth number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 8 numbers = 8 × 44 = 352.

Sum of first five numbers = (3 × 50) + (2 × 52) = 150 + 104 = 254.

Sum of last three numbers (6th, 7th, and 8th) = 352 − 254 = 98.

As 6th is 6 and 8 less than 7th and 8th: 3 × (6th number) + 6 + 8 = 98.

6th number = (98 − 14) ÷ 3 = 28.

8th number = 28 + 8 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 8 numbers = 44

Average of first 3 numbers = 50

Average of next 2 numbers = 52

6th number = 7th number − 6 = 8th number − 8

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of terms

 
 
• 
 
• 
 First 3 (Avg: 50)
 Next 2 (Avg: 52)
 Last 3 (Sum: 98)
 Total Average = 44 (Sum = 352)
 

 6th: x
 7th: x+6
 8th: x+8

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of all 8 numbers = 8 × 44 = 352

⇒ Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 50 = 150

⇒ Sum of next 2 numbers = 2 × 52 = 104

⇒ Sum of 6th, 7th, and 8th numbers = 352 − (150 + 104) = 98

⇒ Let the 6th number be x.

⇒ 7th number = x + 6

⇒ 8th number = x + 8

⇒ x + (x + 6) + (x + 8) = 98

⇒ 3x + 14 = 98

⇒ 3x = 98 − 14 = 84

⇒ x = 28

⇒ 8th number = 28 + 8 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Weighted Average

When groups have different averages: Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Sum of Deviations

The algebraic sum of deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.</p

questions.question: The cost price of 50 articles is same as the selling price of x articles. If there is a profit of 25 percent, then what is the value of x? (Selling price of all articles is same. Cost price of all articles is same)
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

C.P of 50 articles = S.P of X articles 

Profit % = 25%

**Formula used:- **

Profit% = (Profit/Cost price) × 100

Profit = Selling price – Cost price 

**Calculation:-**

(C.P of 1 article) × 50 = (S.P of 1 article) × X 

⇒ C.P/S.P = X/50

Profit = Selling price – Cost price

⇒ 50 – X

 Profit % = (profit/cost price) × 100

⇒ (50 – X)/X × 100 = 25

⇒ (50 – X)/X = 1/4

⇒ 200 – 4X = X

⇒ 5X = 200

⇒ X = 200/5 = 40

** ∴ The required answer is__ 40__.**
